output.rationale: The requirement specifies compliance with IEEE C62.11 for metal-oxide surge arresters in AC power circuits, and the page header indicates this is part of the specification for metal-clad switchgear. Among the candidates, 'CROWN-ARMV' from the CROWN business unit is an engineered-to-order (ETO) product that includes metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear, which aligns with the requirement context. This product is suitable for the application described.
